notes.title: Scorch is Out!
notes.notes:
You can play the game right now, absolutely free. After almost a year of development, publishing, and critical feedback, it's done. It's over.

Now you can experience Scorch on Steam in all of its glory. Brag to your friends about how much time your poured into it, put it on your wishlist, write a snarky review on the store page... think of all the posibilities!

Of course you can still tell us about what you want to see inside the game in the future and you can always report any bugs you find to us.

It has been a real journey to develop this game and I was able to learn a lot about game dev and publishing.

This game would not have been possible without Lea Bormann, Huang Chen, or Lauritz Vogelsang. I am thankful to have been part of such an ambitious team.
